title: COMP 3522 C++ · Week 7
subtitle: static members, copy elision and return value optimization, the right-left rule, and the midterm review: references, operators, virtual, functions, the copy constructor
description: Everything in the Week 7 deck and the Week7 sample programs (static, static_functions, Calculator, StaticCalculator, basic, copy_elision, Inheritance, Inheritance2, oop_multi3, operators, operatorsBasic): static data members declared in the class and defined once outside, the two ways to reach them, the three in-class initialization cases, static member functions and the class you never instantiate, copy elision and return value optimization with the Number class, NRVO, what C++17 guarantees, the three times the copy constructor runs with basic.cpp and copy_elision.cpp run for real, the right-left rule for reading declarations in five steps, and the instructor's review block: references, member versus friend operators, the three meanings of virtual, kinds of functions, shallow and deep copies. Every program runnable with its real output; a mock quiz and a one-page sheet close the week.
intro:
:::quiz The midterm and this week
The midterm is on **Thursday October 29, 2026, 3:30 pm, SW03-1710**: 90 minutes, on paper, one hand-written double-sided cheat sheet, covering **Weeks 1 to 7**. :::
